messages:
maya: heads-up — Delta Edge (Dedicated) rollout proposal: change window Mon Apr 20 02:00–04:00 UTC. Customer confirmed maintenance window. Requesting approvals for canary plan, rollback thresholds, and version pin.

deploy-bot: created change window #CW-4723 for tenant delta-edge, scheduled 2026-04-20T02:00:00Z. Release artifact: rwinference/delta:v2.4.1-quant.

ev an: typo —evan here. quick q: are we pinning runtime/kernel too? last time auto-kernel swap caused perf variance.

sre-lead: recommend pinning kernel to gpu-kernel-2026-03 (we tested 1000qps). Canary=2% traffic for 10m, then 20% for 20m, then ramp to 100% if good. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5x baseline OR P95 latency increase >30% for 10m.

account-eng-janet: customer (Delta Edge) confirmed they can do the 02:00 window, they asked for a short release note to share with ops team.

security-ali: need to confirm KMS key rotation won't break logship. Can you add KMS key id to the preflight? Also request STS tokens refresh in private control plane before cutover.

eng-runtime: we can pin the runtime image to rwinference/runtime:1.7.3-kernel-gpu-kernel-2026-03. I'll add an explicit runtime image override to the rollout manifest.

ops-tom: snippet for rollout manifest (will apply as a canary policy):
```yaml
rollout:
  canary:
    steps:
      - traffic: 2%
        duration: 10m
      - traffic: 20%
        duration: 20m
  runtime_image: rwinference/runtime:1.7.3-kernel-gpu-kernel-2026-03
  model: rwinference/delta:v2.4.1-quant
```

maya: release notes draft to share with customer ops: ```- Bump model to v2.4.1-quant (improved 16-bit perf). - Runtime pinned to runtime:1.7.3 with gpu-kernel-2026-03. - Canary rollout: 2% -> 20% -> full with automatic rollback thresholds. - No prompt/format changes.```

deploy-bot: preflight checks running...
deploy-bot: preflight result: PASSED (KV cache warm check, endpoint health, dependency service smoke tests).

ev an: quick follow-up: metrics we should watch: p95 latency, token/sec, error5xx, gpu utilization. Can we add a temporary dashboard link?

sre-lead: added a one-off dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/delta-edge-rollout (editors: @sre-lead, @evan). Alerts: error rate and latency above.

security-ali: KMS check done, STS tokens rotated on staging. Need account-eng-janet to confirm customer KMS rotation schedule — otherwise we hold.

account-eng-janet: confirmed with Delta Edge: no KMS rotation during our window. They approved.

ops-tom: will enable automatic fallback to hosted model variant if dedicated capacity < 50% during canary. Fallback policy: route 10% to hosted fallback, fail closed if API denies.

maya: final approvals? please react with :thumbsup: if good, or call out blockers.

account-eng-janet: :thumbsup: customer-facing note approved.

sre-lead: :thumbsup: routing, rollback thresholds, and dashboards approved.

security-ali: :lock: approved after KMS/STs verified.

ev an: :thumbsup: kernel pin and metrics dashboard good.

eng-runtime: :thumbsup: runtime image pin confirmed, will block automatic kernel upgrades for this host pool during the window.

deploy-bot: final checklist: approvals (all), preflight (passed), change window locked. Will run canary ramp at 2026-04-20T02:00:00Z.

maya: thanks all, scheduling note posted to customer and infra calendar. I'll be on-call for the window. If anything unusual, call out in this thread and ping @sre on-call.

deploy-bot: scheduled job CW-4723 queued (run_at=1799452800). Good luck! :rocket:
